Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json authored_by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 / wC-050, reviewed_by null); no hardware was attached and no hardware or human claim is made. Only catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue_requests. Not covered: the sim backend (gymnasium.make of the registered id) was not run because the upstream stack (robosuite, MuJoCo 3.2.6, the downloaded tabletop assets) is not installed and its ids are registered only when robocasa.utils.gym_utils is imported; the fake is an analytic F0 stand-in with no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators, sensors, noise or rendering, reward is always 0 and it never terminates, so task success is not modelled; NOT COVERED: the upstream 256 x 256 x 3 uint8 camera image observation, because the fake returns a 2 x 2 x 3 stand-in; NOT COVERED: the language annotation content, which the fake always returns empty. The fake's action keys drop the upstream 'action.' prefix (left_hand instead of action.left_hand) because the Gymnasium bridge addresses a Dict member as action.<key> and a dotted key gives an unresolvable limit path; the sim backend would keep the upstream names and was not run. The action/observation part sizes are the default GR-1 sizes named by the clone (seven per arm, three for the waist, six per Fourier hand) and a different controller configuration can change them. Expected family-driver warnings, not cleared: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 and G8.NO_UNIT x8 (the five action part arrays, ticks and seed twice). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was reported. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the stable digest line the last check printed.
